name: Boston Marathon 2026
description: The world's oldest annual marathon. The 130th edition is held on Patriots' Day, April 20, 2026. Entry requires a qualifying time. Qualifier registration ran September 8–12, 2025; 33,267 applications were received from 116 countries.

name: Tokyo Marathon 2026
description: The 19th edition of the Tokyo Marathon, completed on March 1, 2026. One of the Abbott World Marathon Majors, the race winds through Tokyo's iconic landmarks. Entry is by lottery.

name: TCS London Marathon 2026
description: One of the world's most iconic marathons, running from Greenwich through the Tower of London and finishing near Buckingham Palace. A record 1,133,813 people entered the 2026 ballot, which closed May 2, 2025.

name: BMW Berlin Marathon 2026
description: The 52nd BMW Berlin Marathon, one of the world's largest and fastest marathons. Entry is by lottery (September 25 – November 6, 2025). The flat course through Berlin has produced more world records than any other marathon.

name: Bank of America Chicago Marathon 2026
description: A World Marathon Major winding through 29 Chicago neighborhoods. The general entry lottery ran October 21 – November 18, 2025 and is now closed. Charity entries remain available.

name: TCS New York City Marathon 2026
description: The world's largest marathon by finishers. The non-guaranteed entry drawing ran February 4–25, 2026. The course winds through all five NYC boroughs, finishing in Central Park.

name: TCS Sydney Marathon 2026
description: The newest Abbott World Marathon Major, part of the series since 2025. The 2026 ballot ran September 24 – October 17, 2025. The race showcases Sydney's iconic harbour and skyline.

name: Valencia Marathon Trinidad Alfonso Zurich 2026
description: Ranked #1 in the world for sub-3-hour performance density. The 2026 edition introduced a ballot entry system (December 11–26, 2025); all 36,000 places sold out. The flat city course is ideal for personal bests.

name: California International Marathon 2026
description: A purpose-built fast marathon from Folsom to Sacramento, consistently producing some of the highest sub-3-hour finisher rates in the world. Entry is first-come, first-served with tiered pricing. 2026 date to be confirmed.

name: Zurich Seville Marathon 2026
description: The 41st Zurich Seville Marathon, completed on February 15, 2026. One of the fastest and most popular marathons in Spain, consistently ranked among the world's top races for sub-3-hour performances.

name: Mainova Frankfurt Marathon 2026
description: A flat, fast course through Frankfurt's financial district, drawing over 20,000 participants. No lottery — entry is first-come, first-served with tiered pricing by bib number. Late registration available on-site up to race week.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
description: An IAAF Platinum Label race through Amsterdam's canals, finishing in the historic Olympisch Stadion. Registration opened December 20, 2025. 32,000 marathon places available — tends to sell out quickly.

name: NN Rotterdam Marathon 2026
description: A famously flat and fast course through Rotterdam, renowned as one of the world's best venues for marathon personal bests. Entry is by lottery (pre-registration September 9–22, 2025); 18,000 marathon places available.

name: Dubai Marathon 2026
description: The 25th edition of the Middle East's oldest international marathon, completed February 1, 2026. Held along Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road, the race offers significant prize money and attracts world-class elite runners.

name: Schneider Electric Paris Marathon 2026
description: The 49th edition of the Paris Marathon. One of the world's largest marathons — the 2025 edition set a participation record with 56,950 starters. The course passes the Louvre, Notre-Dame, and the Bois de Boulogne. Registration closed April 24, 2025.

name: Dong-A Seoul Marathon 2026
description: One of Asia's most prestigious marathons, held on March 15, 2026. International registration opened July 1, 2025. A sub-5-hour qualifying time is required. The race starts and finishes at Gwanghwamun Square.

name: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon 2026
description: A World Athletics Platinum Label race and host of the 2026 Age Group World Championships. Starting and finishing at Green Point Stadium on May 24, with iconic views of Table Mountain. Entry is by ballot.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon 2026
description: Held on May 30, 2026, the Stockholm Marathon runs through Sweden's historic capital, finishing in the iconic 1912 Olympic Stadium. Limited to 18,000 participants; runners must be at least 18 years old.

name: Vienna City Marathon 2026
description: Held on April 19, 2026, the Vienna City Marathon passes the Schönbrunn Palace, Vienna State Opera, and Ringstrasse. No lottery — places sold directly on a first-come, first-served basis from June 2025.

name: Athens Marathon: The Authentic 2026
description: The world's most historically significant marathon, retracing the legendary run of Pheidippides from Marathon to Athens in 490 BC. Held every November, the 2025 edition sold out rapidly, making 2026 equally competitive.

name: Wizz Air Milan Marathon 2026
description: The Wizz Air Milan Marathon on April 12, 2026. The course runs through Milan's historic streets and architectural landmarks. Registration is open until April 8, 2026.

name: EDP Lisbon Marathon 2026
description: A 100% ocean- and riverside course from Carcavelos to Praça do Comércio in central Lisbon. Registrations are currently open with tiered pricing — early registration offers the best rates.

name: Haspa Marathon Hamburg 2026
description: The Haspa Marathon Hamburg on April 26, 2026. A flat, fast course through one of Europe's most vibrant port cities. 13,500 marathon places with tiered pricing; bib pickup at the Marathon Expo April 24–25.

name: CNO Financial Indianapolis Monumental Marathon 2026
description: The CNO Financial Indianapolis Monumental Marathon on November 7, 2026. Registration opened at midnight on January 1, 2026. Known for consistently high sub-3-hour finisher rates, ranking among the world's top performance-density marathons.

name: ASICS Gold Coast Marathon 2026
description: The 46th ASICS Gold Coast Marathon, July 4–5, 2026, attracting 39,000+ participants across eight events. The marathon course runs along the Gold Coast's iconic beachside boulevards. Registration is open with tiered pricing through June 21, 2026.

name: JAL Honolulu Marathon 2026
description: The JAL Honolulu Marathon on December 13, 2026. One of the world's largest marathons with no participant cap, drawing 35,000+ runners annually. Set against Hawaii's Pacific coastline with a 5:00 a.m. start.

name: São Paulo International Marathon 2026
description: The largest marathon in South America, starting and finishing in Ibirapuera Park. The race draws over 20,000 runners from around the world and offers multiple distances including marathon, half marathon, and 10K.

name: TCS Toronto Waterfront Marathon 2026
description: The TCS Toronto Waterfront Marathon on October 18, 2026. A flat, fast course along Lake Ontario, popular as a Boston Marathon qualifier. Draws 18,000+ participants from over 72 countries across all race distances.

name: Zurich Marathon 2026
description: The Zurich Marathon on April 12, 2026, through Switzerland's largest city. A scenic lakeside course with around 6,000 participants, offering a more intimate race experience than larger city marathons.

name: Marathon de La Rochelle Serge Vigot 2026
description: One of France's largest marathons, held on November 29, 2026, along the Atlantic coast of La Rochelle. Known for its flat, fast course and festive atmosphere. Ranked among the world's top races for sub-3-hour performance density.
